title: ML-based approach to classification and generation of structured light propagation in turbulent media
summary: We study the classification task of structured-light beams after propagation through a random turbulent medium. The received speckle patterns are generated by numerical simulation of a stochastic paraxial propagation model, and the classification task is formulated over a finite alphabet of 15 OAM source classes. We benchmark intensity and autocorrelation inputs using SimpleCNN and ResNet-18 as classifiers. We also quantify the effect of training-set size and receiver-window misalignment.
